issues.where: the central landmass, from the round basins at left through the paired mountain arcs to the pronged ends at right
issues.what: the land reads immediately as a skeleton with eye sockets, ribs, and fingers; the regularly spaced white ridges and circular basins look drawn into the map
issues.fix: Break the matching ridge arcs and pronged silhouettes with asymmetrical erosion, varied watersheds, irregular crater rims, and interrupted snowlines so the anatomy is suggested rather than outlined.

issues.where: almost the entire dark-blue field, confirmed in the native crops in set-B-08.png and set-B-09.png
issues.what: the apparent ocean is almost a single navy fill from edge to edge, with no legible surface variation, reflected light, or overlying air
issues.fix: Keep the shot dark but recover broad variation with faint grazing reflection, varied wave roughness, and a little atmospheric structure rather than raising the entire blue field.

issues.where: upper-right crop, the parallel snow-capped ridges
issues.what: the white crests have similar width and soft feathering, and the brown slopes below them look smeared rather than cut into distinct rocky faces
issues.fix: Vary snow cover by slope and exposure, sharpen selected ridge relief, and add irregular rock and drainage detail at the native scale.

issues.where: lower-left crop, where the long ridge and its peninsula meet the pale water
issues.what: a thin cyan contour traces the shore at nearly uniform width and separates large flat patches of color, making the shallows look like a mask
issues.fix: Replace the contour with a depth gradient that changes width with the bathymetry, and add broken shoals or localized surf rather than outlining every shore.

issues.where: left crop, the upper-right brown mountain mass and the blue basin below it
issues.what: the brown and white relief bends into broad, smooth, marbled streaks and the basin has a crisp blue perimeter with little interior depth
issues.fix: Break the streaks up with slope-specific erosion and distinct ridge geometry, and shade the basin with uneven shallows instead of a perimeter stroke.

issues.where: lower-right cyclone and the small crimson patch right of center
issues.what: the cyclone winds into a tight, evenly streaked pinwheel, while the crimson patch looks like flat color stamped across the white terrain or cloud
issues.fix: Vary the cyclone's cloud-band widths, height, and shadow; integrate the crimson feature with local terrain and, if it is emissive, give nearby ground and vapor corresponding illumination.
